# The Courtauld

> > The Courtauld is a world-leading centre for the study and display of art history, home to The Courtauld Gallery at Somerset House and The Courtauld Institute of Art.

The Courtauld combines academic excellence in art history education and research with a renowned art collection featuring works by Van Gogh, Botticelli, and other masters. The institution is committed to widening access through initiatives like Art History Link-Up and advancing diversity, inclusion, and anti-racism in the art world.

## Academic Programs and Student Opportunities

- [Study MA History of Art at The Courtauld in 2025 – apply by 20 Jan](https://courtauld.ac.uk/news-blogs/2025/apply-ma-20-jan): MA History of Art applications open, deadline 20 Jan with scholarships
- [The Courtauld's MA Curating the Art Museum students launch their 2022 exhibition in collaboration with the Zaha Hadid Foundation](https://courtauld.ac.uk/news-blogs/2022/the-courtaulds-ma-curating-the-art-museum-students-launch-their-2022-exhibition-in-collaboration-with-the-zaha-hadid-foundation): MA Curating students launch Zaha Hadid Foundation collaboration exhibition
- [Sotiris Felios Collection Art History Residency 2025](https://courtauld.ac.uk/news-blogs/2025/sotiris-felios-collection-art-history-residency-2025): Athens residency opportunity for contemporary Greek art research
- [2020/21 Academic highlights at The Courtauld](https://courtauld.ac.uk/news-blogs/2021/2020-21-academic-highlight): 2020/21 academic year highlights: research awards & faculty achievements

## Access and Inclusion Initiatives

- [The Courtauld to collaborate with Art History Link-Up](https://courtauld.ac.uk/news-blogs/2022/the-courtauld-art-history-link-up): Partnership with Art History Link-Up for state school A-level access
- [Applications are now open for Art History Link-Up (AHLU) September 2024](https://courtauld.ac.uk/news-blogs/2024/applications-are-now-open-for-art-history-link-up-ahlu-september-2024): Free A-level Art History program applications open for state schools
- [April update on Diversity, Inclusion and Anti-Racism](https://courtauld.ac.uk/news-blogs/2021/april-update-on-diversity-inclusion-and-anti-racism): Institutional update on diversity, inclusion & anti-racism initiatives
- [From Bust to Zoom: reflections on a year (and a bit) of online learning in Short Courses](https://courtauld.ac.uk/news-blogs/2021/reflections-online-short-courses): Reflections on transitioning Short Courses to online Zoom teaching
